  Service: Cloud KMS
  SDK: google-cloud-kms
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: encrypt, decrypt
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/kms/docs

  SDK: boto3

  Documented operations: encrypt, decrypt
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: transit.encrypt, transit.decrypt
  Setup hints: VAULT_ADDR, VAULT_TOKEN

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: CryptographyClient.encrypt, CryptographyClient.decrypt
  Setup hints: AZURE_KEY_VAULT_URL
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/key-vault/keys/about-keys

  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

output_text:
```python
import boto3
import os
import struct
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM

class EnvelopeEncryptor:
    IV_LEN = 12

    def __init__(self, key_id: str):
        self.key_id = key_id
        self.kms = boto3.client('kms')

    def encrypt(self, plaintext: bytes) -> bytes:
        dek = os.urandom(32)
        encrypt_response = self.kms.encrypt(
            KeyId=self.key_id,
            Plaintext=dek
        )
        encrypted_dek = encrypt_response['CiphertextBlob']
        iv = os.urandom(self.IV_LEN)
        aesgcm = AESGCM(dek)
        encrypted_data = aesgcm.encrypt(iv, plaintext, None)
        dek_len = len(encrypted_dek)
        envelope = (
            struct.pack('>I', dek_len) +
            encrypted_dek +
            iv +
            encrypted_data
        )
        return envelope

    def decrypt(self, envelope: bytes) -> bytes:
        pos = 0
        dek_len = struct.unpack('>I', envelope[pos:pos + 4])[0]
        pos += 4
        encrypted_dek = envelope[pos:pos + dek_len]
        pos += dek_len
        iv = envelope[pos:pos + self.IV_LEN]
        pos += self.IV_LEN
        encrypted_data = envelope[pos:]
        decrypt_response = self.kms.decrypt(
            KeyId=self.key_id,
            CiphertextBlob=encrypted_dek
        )
        dek = decrypt_response['Plaintext']
        aesgcm = AESGCM(dek)
        plaintext = aesgcm.decrypt(iv, encrypted_data, None)
        return plaintext
```
